meta.title: Ivan Kakurov – Senior Software Engineer
meta.description: Ivan Kakurov – Senior Software Engineer with 13+ years of building and owning complex e-commerce platforms (Symfony, Sylius, Magento 2, Shopware 6). Runs GitOps delivery on Kubernetes and a spec-driven workflow with AI agents. Open-source plugin author. Sofia, Bulgaria.

personal.name: Ivan Jordanov Kakurov
personal.tagline: Senior Software Engineer · E-commerce & Production Systems · PHP/Symfony · GitOps · Agentic Engineering
personal.availability: Open to new opportunities — remote / hybrid / on-site

languages.name: English
languages.level: Professional working proficiency (daily written & technical communication)

summary: Software engineer with 13+ years of building and owning production-critical e-commerce platforms end-to-end (Symfony, Sylius, Magento 2, Shopware 6): architecture, API and data modeling, 15 payment integrations, ERP/CRM synchronization, and GitOps delivery on Kubernetes with Argo CD. Delivers features spec-first with AI agents and reviews every plan, test and diff before it ships. Author of open-source plugins for JetBrains and Sylius and of a cross-runtime agentic SDLC pipeline for legacy codebases.

description: Own the architecture and delivery of the global e-commerce platform abrites.com end-to-end — one platform serving B2B, B2C and B2B2C across 5 independent legal entities, with per-client dynamic pricing and 15 integrated payment providers, 8 built from scratch for regional requirements.

Integrated my open-source Claude Agentic SDLC pipeline into the Abrites codebases, both for the live platform and for new projects: each change gets a risk tier that sets its review, security and test gates, and guard hooks protect legacy behaviour.

Built a GitOps delivery platform on Kubernetes: one generic Helm chart for all projects, Argo CD syncing from a self-hosted GitLab with CI runners, pinned and compatibility-tested versions, and isolated runtimes for legacy applications.

Maintain the internal ERP/CRM (Python/Django + PostgreSQL), a custom Symfony-based CMS, an event management system, a REST API (Django REST Framework + Swagger), GitLab CI pipelines, and a Dolibarr ERP integration.
Delivered large-scale Magento (Adobe Commerce) e-commerce projects in close partnership with the Dutch agency Diract.
Customized core functionality, built custom B2B modules and processes, and redesigned the checkout and invoicing pipeline.
Built the Docker-based CI/CD production flow: containerized environments, automated build and test pipelines, and deployments to Linode servers.
Developed and maintained projects across the full range of scale — from landing pages for local businesses to complex systems for banks and insurance companies.
Built custom e-commerce solutions from scratch.
Worked on a variety of small to mid-scale websites and APIs.

educationNote: Self-taught engineer — 13+ years of continuous hands-on learning in production systems, capped by published open-source work on the JetBrains Marketplace and the official Sylius Addons store.

personalProjects.note: Built with AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, JetBrains Junie), my own tooling and custom MCP commands.

items.name: Claude Agentic SDLC
items.description: Agentic delivery pipeline for Claude Code and Codex, built for legacy production codebases. Each change gets a risk tier (T0–T5) that sets its gates — planning, review, security and test agents, plus guard hooks against out-of-scope edits and pushes to protected branches — and ends at human approval. Tier-based model routing cut the cost of contained (T2) changes by 32%, and cost per request by 8.3% across 7,054 requests.

items.name: Claude Subscription ACP Agent — JetBrains plugin
items.description: JetBrains Marketplace plugin that adds a Claude Subscription (Pro/Max) ACP agent to the AI Assistant chat agent picker — use a Claude subscription directly inside JetBrains IDEs.

items.name: Vanssa Sylius Slider
items.description: Feature-rich responsive slider plugin for Sylius 2, published on the official Sylius Addons store — translatable image and video slides, live admin previews, Symfony UX rendering, Twig Hooks, and optional CMS integrations. Tested with PHPUnit, Behat and Playwright; CI on GitHub Actions. Developed through my agentic SDLC pipeline from human-authored specifications, with every plan, test and diff reviewed before merge.
